sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Current state: bridge at cols 17-28, blocks at cols 42-45
# Need to extend ~14 more cols, each RIGHT adds ~3 cols, so ~5 more RIGHTs
# Execute them one at a time to see when something happens

for i in range(8):
    result = action(['RIGHT'])
    bc = result.get('board_changed')
    ni = result.get('no_impact')
    gc = result.get('gameplay_changed')
    
    # Check bridge extent
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    white_cols = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'w':
            b = n['boundary']
            white_cols.extend([p[1] for p in b])
    
    # Check if colored blocks changed
    blocks = {}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ['R', 'b', 'N'] and n['pixels'] == 16:
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            blocks[n['color']] = (min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols), n['pixels'])
    
    print(f"RIGHT {i+1}: bc={bc}, ni={ni}, gc={gc} | bridge_cols={min(white_cols)}-{max(white_cols)} | blocks={blocks}")
    if ni:
        print("  -> no-impact, stopping")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
